entries.units: velocity m/s; temperature K; pressure Pa; timestamp s
entries.method: Request raw incident-flow/state histories with sensor locations, calibration, clock provenance, uncertainty, missing intervals and configuration identity.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A named gust topic or parked-weather observation is not a matched incident-flow record for an installed dynamic response. No spectrum or operating limit is selected.

entries.units: displacement m; acceleration m/s2; recorded quantity units; timestamp s
entries.method: Request raw installed-response records and channel definitions matched to configuration and incident-flow histories, with calibration, uncertainty, failures and missing coverage.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: P45 stipulated static stiffness is not an observed dynamic response or a load transfer coefficient; no force, moment, stress or structural qualification follows.

entries.units: frequency Hz; sample interval s; calibration/uncertainty units per channel
entries.method: Request documented channel bandwidth, sampling/filtering, calibration and drift, processing versions and uncertainty with retained raw records and gaps.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Missing bandwidth or sampling/calibration provenance leaves dynamic coverage unresolved; no spectrum, bandwidth threshold or physical procedure is prescribed.
